items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1996-01-10
items.q: they had probably the best vaudeville shows where Kid Pelican and all of the big time entertainers would come in and play there from time to time.

ctx.x: Okay, we're back. Okay, this is the, okay, we're back. Tech Stevens, January 10th, 1996, reel number four. Okay. I wonder, well, we were talking about the Palace Theater. Let's keep on with the Palace Theater, because you were going to tell me, and then I've got something else.

Well, the Palace Theater was at the corner of Dauphine and Ioville Street. It was the South's largest and finest theater for color that I could think of. Like I said, Mr. Mosier was the general manager at the time. He was a very nice man. And occasionally, I would go to the theater, because when you went there, you felt like you were walking into a palace, because it was a cultured, you had a cultured atmosphere, and it was probably the largest theater in the greater metropolitan areas as far as seating capacity…
So there would be, so how would it work? I mean, you'd go to see a movie and the live vaudeville?
